name: Historical legal compliance
description: All legally due historical contributions are remitted; State transfers adjust to preserve realised pension payments.
assumptions: No invented reserve; preserve stock-flow consistency.

name: Funding substitution
description: Alternative employer financing substitutes one-for-one for State Budget transfers.

name: Funded reserve
description: Additional employer-equivalent contributions are genuinely additional public expenditure and accumulate in a reserve.
assumptions: Budget cost is explicit; multiple return scenarios.

name: Bank transfer discount-rate sensitivity
description: Revalue transferred bank pension liabilities using alternative discount rates around the legal 4% rate.
